notes: five taḥwīl and second-isnad branches; «كلهم عن أشعث» writes Ash'ath once for all of them, and «بإسناد أبي الأحوص» is a back_reference to another chain
«جميعا حدثنا شعبة» joins the first two branches at شعبة; I placed شعبة in both, as the text's joint wording gives
«حدثنا أبي» is rule 7: a bare father, a relation; «جميعا عن سفيان» is read as joining the route at سفيان
the text names Abd al-Rahman b. Mahdi and Ash'ath, which the K6I index lacks

fixes.reason: K6I index omits عبد الرحمن بن مهدي and the shared tail أشعث بن أبي الشعثاء, and never names زائدة, although the text writes them.

evidence.quote: حدثنا عبد الرحمن بن مهدي، جميعا عن سفيان
